summary: Startup config rewrite adds DeepSeek's balance URL and prices to a custom provider
explanation: Reasonix 1.19.4 upgrades the user config on every start (cli/cli.go -> config/pricing.go ApplyUserConfigUpgradesOnStartup). Loading starts from built-in defaults whose first provider is DeepSeek, and the merged result is written back, so a user-defined OpenAI-compatible provider (here name "abb", base_url pointing at another vendor) gains `balance_url = "https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance"` and DeepSeek's `price` table, and config_version is bumped. Evidence requirement: the config file read back by the agent after start, showing the custom provider block with DeepSeek's balance_url/price that the written config did not contain. The model's own edits to the config, or the version bump alone, do not establish this defect.
expected_behavior: Upgrading the config preserves a custom provider as written; DeepSeek-specific billing endpoints and prices are not attached to other vendors' providers.
observed_behavior: In 10 of 10 independent runs on 1.19.4 the config written with config_version = 1 and no billing keys read back as config_version = 5 with balance_url = https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance and price = {cache_hit 0.0028, input 0.14, output 0.28} on the custom "abb" provider.
